{{Top|leg}}
'''Echo Four''' was the callsign given to a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] in [[Echo Flight]], a [[N-X Police Cruiser/Legends|N-X Police Cruisers]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] in the [[Naboo Royal Space Fighter Corps/Legends|Naboo Royal Space Fighter Corps]]. 

When the adversaries received reinforcements, and [[Bravo Eight]] [[Dren Melne]] turned against them, [[Flight leader/Legends|Flight Leader]] [[Essara Till]] ordered Four and others to keep concentrating against the old fighters. During the [[Starfighter combat/Legends|dogfight]], Till heard a panicked cry from Four as the pilot was pursued, followed by static.<ref name="The Starfighter Trap">{{GamerCite|1|The Starfighter Trap}}</ref>
